summary: Validated 'Impor Produk Excel' feature end-to-end. Backend POST /api/products/bulk works correctly: admin can create new products, update existing products while preserving stok, merge harga_channel, and errors are reported for rows missing sku/name. Kasir receives 403 as expected. Frontend DaftarHarga page: Template & Impor Excel buttons visible for admin only (hidden for kasir). Uploaded a .xlsx built with openpyxl using the documented column order (SKU, Nama Produk, Kategori, Satuan, Harga Beli, Harga Normal, Harga Reseller, Stok, Stok Minimal, Harga <channel>...) - products appear in the table with correct prices including channel prices (Shopee / Tokopedia). Initial state verified empty (0 products). All TEST_* data cleaned up after testing; final product count = 0 as the user requested a fully empty store.

issues: Minor hydration console warning: <span> rendered inside <option> at DaftarHarga.jsx line 110 (option label contains an inline wrapper span). React warns this causes a hydration error. Does not break functionality.

action_items: Optional: fix hydration warning in DaftarHarga.jsx line 110 - avoid wrapping the <option> text in a <span> (strip the dev-tool x-source span inside <option>).
No functional action items - import feature works as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: bulk_products correctly protects stok on update (doc.pop('stok')) and merges harga_channel - good.
bulk endpoint uses require_admin dependency - 403 confirmed for kasir.
readProductExcel in exporter.js maps columns by position starting index 9 for channels - matches exportProductTemplate column order, OK.
Minor: bulk_products doesn't validate duplicate SKUs within the same upload batch; a duplicate within one file will trigger update after insert. Low priority.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin sees buttons, kasir hidden, upload creates & updates products visible in table)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_BULK_001/002/003/004 (backend tests - auto-cleaned via fixture) and TEST_UI_001/002 (UI test - cleaned via DELETE API in teardown). Final product count verified = 0.

Frontend import flow is DaftarHarga -> ProductImport component which uses readProductExcel/exportProductTemplate from /app/frontend/src/lib/exporter.js. Products collection was empty at start and left empty after test. If re-testing, use openpyxl to build the xlsx file; the browser automation env requires `pip install openpyxl` first.
